A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Before we visit.

Can I combine several services in one quote?

Yes. Select every service you are interested in. We can coordinate cleaning, restoration and lighting around your priorities and the appropriate sequence of work.

Will every surface be pressure washed?

No. The method depends on the material, coating and condition. Soft washing, pure-water cleaning and pressure washing each suit different tasks.

What affects the price?

The size and quantity of surfaces, soil level, height, access, material condition and any specialist treatment. Your quote defines what is included.

Do you need access to water or electricity?

Requirements vary with the scope and duration. We confirm access, water, power and parking needs before the visit.

Can you remove every stain?

Some stains sit below the surface or reflect permanent weathering. We discuss likely results and whether a test area or separate restoration treatment is needed.
